substeps.label: O.1
substeps.caption: Oct 6: the plate was clocked straight down the slope, and the stack slid in far enough that its upper sonotrode stood under the nozzle.

substeps.label: O.2
substeps.caption: Sealing rod up: the stream lands on the upper sonotrode, not the plate. The melt gathers round it and drips onto the plate, where it freezes: almost nothing atomizes.

substeps.label: O.3
substeps.caption: About three-quarters of the way through, Gage pulled the stack back about 40 mm. The stream clears the upper sonotrode now, but lands near the plate's free end.

substeps.label: O.4
substeps.caption: Some of it atomizes now, but most of the melt is already on the upper sonotrode and the plate: very little powder (4yghtr). Before closing the door, check the stream will land mid-plate, beside the upper sonotrode.
